purpose: Market Events UI concept mockups for review, not live dashboard data

concepts.name: 01-compact-agenda
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished, realistic high-fidelity screenshot concept improving the Market Events popover in the supplied screenshot. Image 1 is the reference/edit target for the existing financial dashboard. Keep its light gray/white financial workstation character and dense tables, but completely replace the dysfunctional calendar popup. No perspective, no device frame, no explanatory arrows or annotations. Landscape 1600 x 900. Show the lower portion of the dashboard and the complete bottom navigation dock. The popup should be the clear focal point at readable scale, with just enough background tables for context. Light mode only: white surfaces, dark charcoal text, cool pale-gray section bars, delicate 1px gray dividers, very subtle shadow, squared corners or at most 4px radius. Neutral restrained Arial/Inter-like typography, normal weight event names/values, medium-bold headings. All visible event names fully spelled out, NEVER ellipses. No giant blank area, no decorative illustrations, no sidebars, no colored pills, no charts inside the calendar, no blue outlines or links. The content below is a design-example schedule copied from reference context; add NO prices, forecasts, consensus, live badges, order buttons, fake financial numbers. Use exactly these event rows: Mon 14 Sep, 8:30a, CA, CPI m/m; Mon 14 Sep, 8:30a, CA, Median CPI y/y; Mon 14 Sep, 8:30a, CA, Trimmed CPI y/y; Tue 15 Sep, 2:00a, UK, Claimant Count Change. Sunday 13 Sep has 'No high-impact events'. Header 'MARKET EVENTS', tiny secondary 'ET', '3 DAY' and 'WEEK' controls with active 3 DAY shown by subtle gray rectangular fill, and a small gray X on far right. Source 'Forex Factory' small and muted in the header or compact footer. Date-based upcoming events ONLY, do not add extra events. Bottom dock is centered, compact, strictly one row, static labels and static widths: 'Dashboard' | 'Research' with separate upward chevron segment | 'Portfolio' with separate upward chevron segment | 'Prediction Markets' with separate upward chevron segment | 'Market Events' with upward chevron | 'The Analyst' and three tiny gray position squares | 'Systems' with one tiny gray status square. Active 'Market Events' has pale-gray fill, no bold-width change. Never append CPI/Brent or another selected market name to dock. Do not include bottom-left Market Dashboard wordmark. Popup floats ~12px above dock and never touches or covers it. Preserve the surrounding table appearance from the reference as background, no unrelated app redesign. Popup height should hug its actual content. OPTION 1: COMPACT AGENDA. Make a centered popup approximately 760px wide and 370px high in the 1600x900 scene. One slim header across the entire popup. Below, date groups stacked VERTICALLY as a clean agenda. Small pale-gray date separator labels 'TODAY · SUN 13 SEP', 'TOMORROW · MON 14 SEP', 'TUE 15 SEP'. Sunday empty state takes only ONE compact row. Monday has THREE distinct full-width event rows; Tuesday ONE full-width event row. Each event row uses fixed aligned columns for time (left 70px), country (40px), event name (remaining width). Exactly aligned baselines and 30px rows. Normal text, almost no ornamental chrome. This is the most compact and immediately readable alternative. No multi-column calendar; wide event names run across popup. Keep no empty large rectangle anywhere.
